references.text: Pharaoh's threat that Moses would die if he saw his face again, which Moses responds to here
Moses continues speaking to Pharaoh about the final plague, despite having said he would not see Pharaoh's face again, suggesting this conversation continued immediately
Pharaoh calls for Moses and Aaron during the night after the tenth plague, but Moses does not go personally to Pharaoh again as he had said
The Lord's promise to raise up a prophet like Moses, who would also speak God's words with boldness
Moses left Egypt without fearing the king's anger, by faith, relating to his courageous farewell words to Pharaoh
Highlights the limit of human encounter: Moses stops seeing Pharaoh, but God explains that no one can see His face and live.
Contrast between Moses' request for God's presence (33:15) and his conclusion of the meeting with Pharaoh (10:29).
